description: This Swift source file defines protocols, enums, and a struct related to local notification management within an iOS application. It encapsulates notification authorization status handling and notification scheduling functionalities using UserNotifications framework.

classes.name: LiveNotificationCenter
classes.description: A struct implementing notification management functionalities, including authorization status checking and scheduling notifications, using an underlying UNUserNotificationCenter instance.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current notification authorization status from the user notification center.

methods.name: requestAuthorization
methods.description: Requests notification permission from the user with specified options, asynchronously and throws on failure.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Schedules a notification request asynchronously, with error handling.
